hyps.why: A conv shortcut on edge 3 masks the benefit of upgrading edge 5.
A conv direct edge already supplies capacity, so the edge 4 upgrade adds less.
A skip parent preserves the signal, so downstream conv adds more than with other parents.
Skip upstream leaves node 2 unmodified, so conv on edge 5 is complementary rather than redundant.
Conv followed by conv is redundant, so the downstream upgrade is worth less.
Pooled input gives the following conv smoothed features to refine.
A 3x3 kernel complements a 1x1 parent by adding spatial context.
Without the direct edge, edge 5 is a main route into the output, so conv there matters more.
With edge 1 removed, node 1 is cut off from the cell, so edge 4 has no input and the edit's effect depends on the remaining paths.
A large receptive field is already present upstream, so an extra 3x3 adds little.
